title: Confusion Follows the Killing of Massa Ranghar

blocks.text: After the blow falls, the Mughal camp collapses into confusion. As the din and noise continued through the compound, the attackers had already ridden well beyond immediate pursuit, leaving the soldiers to shout, search, and discover too late what had happened.
The emotional balance then reverses across Punjab. The Sikh side celebrates the cleansing of the shrine, while the family of Massa Ranghar and his supporters enter mourning and alarm in Lahore.

The Nawab experiences the killing as both insult and political danger. He becomes desperate to identify the culprits, because the beheading proves that even a protected tyrant can be reached by determined Singhs.
